title: tool-call context manager: deterministic result injection, safe parallel calls, and OpenAI-compat improvements
author: Aisha Khan
description: Motivation: multi-tool workflows have several ergonomic and correctness pain points: nondeterministic injection ordering when tools are executed in parallel, difficulty implementing idempotent retries for side-effecting tools, and inconsistent OpenAI-compatible shape for tool results in streaming responses. This PR introduces a lightweight tool-call context manager in the runtime and API layers to provide deterministic result injection, safe parallel execution with optional backpressure, retry-idempotency tokens, and small OpenAI-compat surface tweaks so client SDKs benefit immediately. Summary of changes: 1) runtime: ToolCallContext - a per-request execution context that tracks tool invocation order, surfaces deterministic injection indices, and stores idempotency tokens for retried calls. The context allows parallel execution of independent tool calls while preserving a stable injection order for the assistant output payload. 2) API/compat: when streaming responses contain tool outputs we now emit a stable structured "tool_calls" array in the OpenAI-compat stream events; each tool entry includes injection_index, idempotency_token, status (ok|error|retrying), and a compact schema-hint field used by SDKs to validate structured output. 3) Execution: introduced a soft-backpressure semaphore for tool fan-out that can be configured per-route (default: concurrency cap 8) with an escape hatch for low-latency workloads (fire-and-forget mode). 4) Retries: tooling/runtime now attaches a retry token with deterministic semantics so side-effecting tool adapters can implement best-effort deduplication; the adapter contract is optional and backward compatible. 5) Structured-output validation: added a best-effort validator hook that runs on returned tool payloads; if validation fails, the runtime injects a normalized assistant message explaining the schema mismatch and attaches the raw tool payload to the tool_calls array. 6) SDKs and docs: small compatibility updates for TS/Python SDKs to expose the tool_calls stream events and helpers to reorder injected results into the application-visible sequence. CI and testing: new unit tests for deterministic ordering and integration tests simulating parallel tool calls, adapter retry flows, and schema mismatch fallbacks. Backwards compatibility: default behavior preserves existing single-tool flows and non-streaming responses; OpenAI-compat streaming gains additional fields but remains parsable by existing clients that ignore unknown keys. Migration notes and config knobs are documented in the PR. Rationale: this change lets developers reason about tool semantics when mixing parallelism, retries, and streaming; it reduces flakiness in app-level orchestration and makes the OpenAI-compat stream a more predictable surface for SDKs and downstream consumers.

review_comments: Marco Rivera: Nice approach. Two concerns: (1) ensure the idempotency token is stable across retries that are automatic vs user-initiated; (2) can the 'tool_calls' fields be added behind a feature flag so enterprise customers can delay parsing changes?

Author (Aisha Khan): For (1) tokens are derived from request id + invocation ordinal by default; adapters can override with explicit token if they need sticky dedup keys. For (2) yes, added a per-tenant feature-flag gate and documented the default-on rollout plan.
Evan Li: Can we avoid blocking latency-sensitive single-tool flows with the new semaphore? Suggest a fast-path for unary tool calls that bypasses backpressure if route config sets concurrency=1.
Author (Aisha Khan): Added an escape hatch 'fire_and_forget' mode and a fast-path when concurrency==1. Also added a test that verifies low-latency behavior.

Sophie Turner: Schema validator seems fine, but we should be careful to not lose raw tool output if validator transforms. Recommend attaching raw payload as base64 in tool_calls so it is audit-friendly.
Author (Aisha Khan): Implemented raw payload attachment (base64) for mismatch cases and added storage-size guard to avoid large-field DOS vectors.
release_notes: Add ToolCallContext for deterministic tool result injection, configurable soft backpressure for parallel tool calls, idempotency token support for retries, and OpenAI-compat streaming updates (tool_calls array + schema-hint). SDKs updated to parse tool_calls streams. Backward compatible by default.
